**Breaking News: Rudolf Atamalyan Joins Neftchi Baku PFC**

In a move that is set to shake up the Azerbaijani football scene, sources close to the club have confirmed that Rudolf Atamalyan has officially signed with Neftchi Baku PFC. According to a statement released by the club, Atamalyan, a talented footballer with a wealth of experience, has put pen to paper on a multi-year deal with the capital city-based team. "We are thrilled to welcome Rudolf to the Neftchi Baku family," said Elkhan Mammadov, the club's sporting director, in an exclusive interview. "His skills and expertise will undoubtedly strengthen our squad and help us achieve our goals in the upcoming season." Atamalyan, who has previously played for several top-tier clubs in the region, brings a level of professionalism and dedication that is expected to inspire his new teammates. "Rudolf is a top-class player who will undoubtedly make an impact on the pitch," said Neftchi Baku's head coach, Laurentiu Reghecampf. "We are confident that he will help us push for a top-three finish in the Azerbaijan Premier League this season." Data from reputable football sources, including Transfermarkt and Sofascore, confirms that Atamalyan has indeed joined Neftchi Baku PFC. The club's official website and social media channels have also announced the signing, with fans eagerly awaiting the player's debut. In terms of statistics, Atamalyan boasts an impressive record, with 15 goals and 7 assists in his last 30 appearances. His pace, agility, and vision on the pitch make him a formidable opponent for any defense. As the new season gets underway, Neftchi Baku PFC fans will be eagerly watching to see how Atamalyan fits into the team's strategy and contributes to their quest for success. **Key Facts:**
